description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 26.11.2018 to 02.12.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. This content falls squarely under the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette as it constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for customs operations, specifically through the issuance of a statutory instrument (the notification) that modifies how existing laws are applied.
